name: Badge
description: A compact label that is not interactive. Replaces the flight status badge, aircraft badge and tier badge.

provenance.tag: A · unverified (neutral, success, warning, error, premium), Rec (info, brand)

variants.name: neutral
variants.description: --color-bg-muted background, --color-text-default text, no border. Example: "Airbus A380-800".

variants.name: info
variants.description: Example: "Boarding". File A uses brand red; remapped per D6 because status colours never use brand red.

source.tag: Rec. File A uses brand red; remapped per D6.

variants.name: brand
variants.description: --color-bg-brand background, --color-text-on-brand text, no border. Example: "Best fare".

props.name: icon
props.description: --icon-size-xs. Required for success, warning, error and info, so status never relies on colour alone. The icon is decorative; the badge text carries the meaning.

presets.name: FlightStatusBadge
presets.description: Badge with a status variant: On time / Confirmed → success + check-circle; Delayed / Gate change → warning + clock; Cancelled → error + x-circle; Boarding → info + airplane-takeoff (not red, D6); Departed / Landed → neutral + airplane-in-flight / airplane-landing.

source.tag: A · unverified (green, amber, error red); Rec (Boarding remapped per D6; Departed / Landed)

presets.name: AircraftBadge
presets.description: Badge variant="neutral". A custom aircraft silhouette icon is optional (custom icon, not in Phosphor).

presets.name: TierBadge
presets.description: Skywards Blue / Silver / Gold / Platinum. Platinum uses variant="premium". Blue, Silver and Gold colours are not defined in any source, so they use neutral until official values exist.

source.tag: A · unverified (Platinum premium); Blue, Silver, Gold colours: no source

requirements: Badges are plain text. Status meaning is in the text ("Delayed"), not just the colour or icon.

rules: Status badges never use brand red (D6).

ambiguities.description: Skywards Blue, Silver and Gold tier colours are not defined in any source; TierBadge uses neutral for them until official values exist.
